overview_description.description:
NCino offers a cloud-based bank operating system created by bankers for bankers. The system helps increase profitability, productivity gains, regulatory compliance, and operational transparency at all organizational levels as well as across all lines of business.

Following a process structure similar to a bank’s loan accounting system, the bank operating system offers combined services through its business process management, loan lifecycle, business intelligence, and document management solutions.

product.name: nCino Platform
product.description: A cloud-based banking platform that integrates lending, account opening, analytics, risk management, automation, and banking-system connectivity for financial institutions.

product.name: Commercial Lending
product.description: A lending solution for managing commercial credit processes, including loan origination, underwriting, approval, documentation, and relationship management.

product.name: Digital Partners
product.description: Role-based AI agents that perform banking tasks, coordinate workflows, and support executives, analysts, service teams, processors, and clients.

product.name: Banking & Mortgage Advisor
product.description: A generative AI interface that provides context-specific guidance and assists with banking and mortgage workflows, documents, calculations, and information retrieval.

product.name: Mortgage
product.description: A cloud-based mortgage lending solution that manages mortgage workflows and supports borrower interactions from application through completion.

product.name: Consumer Lending
product.description: A consumer-loan origination and workflow solution that supports digital applications, credit processing, decisioning, and customer interactions across channels.
